People: Daniel Defoe (author, Wikidata Q40946), died 1731. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Defoe, Daniel, 1661?-1731") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Little Blue Book #145 - Great Ghost Stories, 1924, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/little_blue_book_145_great_ghost_stories_1924. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 93%, 85%, 85% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Daniel Defoe, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
